title: Happy chick
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- soft glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='38' fill='#3a2a10' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#ffb800' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='20' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='7' fill='#fff6b8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='62' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#ffc21a' transform='rotate(-15 22 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='62' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#ffc21a' transform='rotate(15 78 62)'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff8a00'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff8a00'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#3a1f5c'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#3a1f5c'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='34.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='34.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 42 L44 48 L56 48 Z' fill='#ff8a00'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#ff9e5e' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#ff9e5e' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- tiny tuft -->
  <path d='M50 16 Q52 10 56 12 Q54 15 50 16 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
</svg>
